title: Multiple sortBySelector interfere with each other
body:
I want to sort my orders by multiple attributes. I've created replicas for my primary index:
![](https://cl.ly/2u451Z22460V/Image%202018-02-22%20at%202.14.59%20PM.png)

Then, on my js (coffeescript), I use instantsearch for adding multiple sortBySelectors:

```
  search.addWidget(
    instantsearch.widgets.sortBySelector
      container: '#sortBySelectorUserName'
      indices: [
        { name: 'Order_development', label: 'User name' },
        { name: 'order_user_name_asc', label: 'User name asc' },
        { name: 'order_user_name_desc', label: 'User name desc' }
      ],
      cssClasses:
        select: ['sort-by']
  )

  search.addWidget(
    instantsearch.widgets.sortBySelector
      container: '#sortBySelectorCustomerName'
      indices: [
        { name: 'Order_development', label: 'Customer name' },
        { name: 'order_customer_name_asc', label: 'Customer name asc' },
        { name: 'order_customer_name_desc', label: 'Customer name desc' }
      ],
      cssClasses:
        select: ['sort-by']
  )
```

Unfortunately, when I change one of the dropdowns, the other one gets affected as well:
![](https://cl.ly/0F2R3z3a1c1H/Screen%20Recording%202018-02-22%20at%2002.18%20PM.gif)

How can I keep the label name on the other dropdowns while sorting?
Perhaps I'm missing a key concept?
